from.place: Pairwise Laurent-unit calculation used by the off-diagonal normalization.

title: Pairwise Laurent unit expansion on projective-space overlaps
statement: Let k be a field and r>=3. Every family of units on standard projective-space chart overlaps admits, on each pair of distinct indices, a scalar unit on the first chart and an integer Laurent exponent expressing the overlap unit as the scalar restriction times the standard transition unit.

proof.text: Use chartRingEquiv to identify the j-th chart section ring R with k[X_l : l != j]. The coordinate p = x_i/x_j corresponds to X_i and is prime by MvPolynomial.X_prime. By basicOpen_coordRatio and IsAffineOpen.isLocalization_of_eq_basicOpen, the section ring on U_i intersect U_j is the localization of R away from p.

For a unit t in this localization clear a denominator: t*q^n = image(a), where q is ratioUnit i j. The image of a is a unit, so a divides p^N by IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit_iff. Apply dvd_prime_pow to write a = p^m*v for a unit v of R, and cancel q^n in the unit group. Thus t = image(v)*q^(m-n). This is the proved private helper exists_unit_zpow_of_localization.

Map v back through chartRingEquiv. MvPolynomial.isUnit_iff_eq_C_of_isReduced says that it is a nonzero scalar c. Use chartRingEquiv_C and functoriality of restriction to identify its restriction with standardOpenConstUnit on the i-th chart. Apply choice to the resulting pairwise expansions, assigning arbitrary exponent zero and coefficient one on the unused diagonal.

lean.statement: theorem exists_pairwise_laurent_unit_expansion (k : Type u) [Field k] (r : ℕ) (hr : 3 ≤ r) (t : ∀ i j : ULift.{u} (Fin r), Γ(ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin r); Spec (.of k)), standardOpen _ (Spec (.of k)) i ⊓ standardOpen _ (Spec (.of k)) j)ˣ) : ∃ e : ∀ i j : ULift.{u} (Fin r), ℤ, ∃ c : ∀ i j : ULift.{u} (Fin r), kˣ, ∀ i j : ULift.{u} (Fin r), i ≠ j → (t i j).val = (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin r); Spec (.of k))).presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op (standardOpenConstUnit k r i (c i j)).val * (transitionUnit _ (Spec (.of k)) (e i j) i j).val
